'''Colin McCann''' won the [[1997 Hoth Regionals (Toronto)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I'm 16, and live in Thornhill, Ontario."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/mccann.html Colin McCann], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428004424/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/mccann.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"I qualified for the World Finals at the Hoth Toronto Regional, where I faced off against Alex Kuryliak,."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"a great sportsman and a great opponent I've been playing Star Wars CCG since the early days when it first came out."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite Star Wars lines, without a doubt are R2's beeps."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I'm ready for Norfolk and hope to reclaim the Championship for Hoth, bringing it back to Canada for yet another year."<ref name="dec97bio" />
